aliases: switchyards Switchyard earthing and lightning interfaces
summary: Identifies the sheath-section interconnections used by the assigned cross-bonded cable system.
description: Identifies the sheath-section interconnections used by the assigned cross-bonded cable system. Earthing and lightning interfaces identify the connections between equipment metalwork, primary protection devices and the station earthing network. Their electrical purpose differs from their physical conductor route or electrode geometry.

In a switchyard arrangement, the earthing references help connect each primary equipment structure and surge-protection device to the correct earth-grid interface. Separate details show actual joints, sizes and installation routes. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Sectioned cable sheaths” at the input and “Cross-bonding connections” at the output. Section lengths and joint arrangements require a cable design.

Name every connected item and the earthing design reference. The illustrative connection does not establish touch or step voltages, conductor sizing, lightning coverage or safe working conditions. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
